title: Adventure Craft
description:
ABOUT THIS GAMEAdventure Craft is a procedurally generated open-world PvE survival crafting action RPG where exploration, preparation and survival go hand in hand.

Explore a vast world, gather resources, hunt for food and loot, craft powerful equipment, build a place to call home and prepare yourself for the dangers that emerge as the world changes from day to night.

SURVIVE A CHANGING WORLDThe world of Adventure Craft becomes a very different place after dark. Explore and gather what you need during the day, then prepare for the monsters and other dangers that emerge at night.

EXPLORE A PROCEDURALLY GENERATED WORLDVenture across a vast procedurally generated landscape filled with different biomes, wildlife, monsters, resources and hidden discoveries.

No two journeys through the world need to be the same.

CRAFT WEAPONS, ARMOUR AND EQUIPMENTCollect materials and loot from throughout the world and use them to craft a wide variety of weapons, armour and other equipment.

Finding new resources opens up new possibilities and new ways to survive.

BUILD AND CUSTOMIZE YOUR HOMECreate a home in the wilderness and make it your own with furniture, decorations and other objects you discover or craft.

Your home gives you a place to prepare before heading back out into the world.

DESCEND INTO DANGEROUS CAVESExplore deep underground cave systems filled with valuable treasure, rare resources and powerful creatures that hide from the world above.

The deeper you travel, the greater the danger — and the potential rewards.

FIGHT A WORLD FULL OF PvE THREATSBattle wildlife, monsters and other hostile creatures using the weapons and equipment you create and discover.

Different enemies, environments and situations encourage you to change how you prepare, equip yourself and fight.

CREATE YOUR OWN PARTYUse cloning technology to create custom party members and configure their behaviour using the AI Creator.

Build a group suited to the way you want to explore and survive.

TRAIN ANIMAL COMPANIONSRaise and train an attack dog that grows stronger, gains experience and learns new abilities over time.

Take your companion with you as you explore, fight and survive the world of Adventure Craft.
description_short: Adventure Craft is a procedurally generated open-world PvE survival crafting action RPG. Explore, gather resources, hunt monsters, craft weapons and armour, build a home, train companions, and survive a dangerous world that changes from day to night.
